name: Antipasti Pasta Salad with Crispy Prosciutto, Artichokes & Mozzarella

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.

Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, lay prosciutto in the skillet and cook until it browns slightly, about 1 minute per side. Transfer to a plate and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil
6 slices prosciutto

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 red bell peppers
1 small pkg fresh basil
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Seed and slice bell peppers into thin strips. Peel and mince onion.
Return skillet to stove over medium-high heat. Add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add peppers, onion, and salt; cook, stirring often, until crisp-tender, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Add to the skillet with the peppers during the last 30 seconds of cooking. Remove both from heat and set aside to cool.
Combine oil, vinegar, Dijon, and spices in a large salad bowl and whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
⅓ cup red wine vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
½ tsp onion powder
½ tsp Italian seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Drain and thinly slice artichoke hearts; transfer to the bowl with the dressing.
Cut cheese into ½-inch cubes; transfer to the bowl.
Halve olives and add to the bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl.
When the pasta is done cooking, drain and rinse under cold, running water. Transfer pasta, bell pepper mixture, and arugula to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Chop or tear prosciutto into pieces.
To serve, divide pasta salad between plates or bowls and top with crispy prosciutto. Enjoy!
